dedupe_keys.name: smart meter energy data from a controlled environment

description: Iskraemeco publishes controlled smart-meter experiments from a laboratory representing one transformer and five houses. Zenodo provides measurements and setup illustrations free under CC BY 4.0. The six meters record phase voltages, currents, active power and power factors while loads and connections are varied. Two dataset generations use five-second and one-second sampling, respectively, with topology and wire lengths held constant but different data formats. These experiments can calibrate energy-balance and anomaly-detection observations in low-voltage network simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this testbed. Coverage is a configurable laboratory, not a six-building field survey. The provider reports unresolved discrepancies between summed house measurements and the transformer meter, especially on phase L2. Absolute accuracy and the cause of these discrepancies remain uncertain. No archive was downloaded or meter error corrected.
